title: Run Planner
description: Build an explicit, reviewable session plan before starting the automation engine.

sections.title: Destination
sections.description: Choose the game surface and strategy. Options stay disabled until their recognition and execution gates pass.

settings.label: Battle destination
settings.summary: Select where the session is allowed to enter battles.
settings.description: Regular, Ranked, Legend, and Builder Base are separate routes with different entry screens, limits, and stop behavior. The engine never silently substitutes one route for another.

options.label: Regular battles
options.description: Uses the regular multiplayer route and the configured farming filters. This route is kept separate from Ranked and Legend battles.
options.disabled_reason: Current-client entry recognition and runtime evidence are not complete.

options.label: Ranked battles
options.summary: Use the dedicated Ranked battle route.
options.description: Consumes Ranked attacks and must display the available-attack count before start. It cannot fall back to regular multiplayer search.
options.disabled_reason: Ranked navigation and attack-limit recognition are still awaiting fixtures and controlled validation.
options.warning: This mode consumes a limited battle allocation.

options.label: Legend League
options.summary: Use the current tiered Legend League route.
options.description: Reads the current Legend tier, remaining attacks, and schedule state before allowing a session to start.
options.disabled_reason: Tier and remaining-attack recognition are not yet verified.
options.warning: This mode consumes a limited battle allocation.

options.label: Builder Base
options.summary: Run Builder Base attacks and post-battle collection.
options.description: Uses the Builder Base route, Builder Base army state, builder count, reward cart, and its own stop conditions.
options.disabled_reason: Current Builder Base builder and post-battle states require fixture validation.

settings.label: Attack strategy
settings.summary: Choose the deployment policy used after a route is verified.
settings.description: Strategies are engine capabilities, not visual presets. A strategy remains unavailable when required troops, deployment-bar recognition, or route-specific evidence is missing.

options.label: Scripted CSV
options.summary: Use an existing reviewed CSV deployment script.
options.description: Runs the selected legacy CSV script through the existing parser and red-area deployment engine. The profile must reference a valid script.

options.label: Standard deployment
options.summary: Use the built-in standard deployment controls.
options.description: Uses the existing standard attack settings and drop order. Current-client troop-bar recognition must pass before live use.
options.disabled_reason: Current attack-bar recognition has not been revalidated.

options.label: Smart Farm
options.summary: Use the existing collector-aware farming algorithm.
options.description: Targets recognized external collectors and follows configured resource filters. It requires current collector and red-area fixtures.
options.disabled_reason: Town Hall 18-era collector and boundary fixtures are incomplete.

options.label: Builder Base: Baby Dragons
options.summary: Deploy a Builder Base Baby Dragon army.
options.description: Uses a dedicated Builder Base route and must verify the current army bar, Hero slot, surrender or end-battle flow, and reward-cart return state.
options.disabled_reason: The clean-room Builder Base strategy adapter is not implemented yet.

sections.title: Environment
sections.description: Select a supported local Android environment and instance.

settings.label: Android environment
settings.summary: Choose which installed emulator adapter the engine controls.
settings.description: Auto-detect lists only installations found on this computer. Explicit selection is recommended for multi-instance testing and reproducible diagnostics.

options.label: Auto-detect
options.summary: Select the first compatible installed environment.
options.description: Discovers supported installations and preserves the configured instance when it remains valid.

options.label: BlueStacks 5
options.description: Uses the inherited BlueStacks 5 integration, including background capture and the configured Android instance.
options.disabled_reason: The inherited adapter has not completed the current-client emulator matrix.

options.label: MEmu
options.description: Uses the inherited MEmu integration and its configured instance and ADB endpoint.
options.disabled_reason: The inherited adapter has not completed the current-client emulator matrix.

options.label: Nox
options.description: Uses the inherited Nox integration and its configured instance and ADB endpoint.
options.disabled_reason: The inherited adapter has not completed the current-client emulator matrix.

options.label: LDPlayer 9
options.description: Discovers LDPlayer 9, resolves standard multi-instance ADB ports, configures the required resolution and DPI, and exposes background-mode hooks.
options.disabled_reason: Static integration passes; controlled instance and background-capture evidence is still required.

options.label: MuMu Player 12
options.summary: Use the new MuMu Player adapter.
options.description: Discovers MuMu Player, reads the instance ADB endpoint from configuration, configures the required resolution and DPI, and selects the renderer-aware background mode.
options.disabled_reason: Static integration passes; controlled instance and background-capture evidence is still required.

settings.label: Instance
settings.summary: Choose the exact Android instance controlled by this run.
settings.description: The list is populated from the selected emulator. The saved value is an instance identifier, not a display title or account credential.

sections.title: Stop conditions
sections.description: A run stops when the first enabled condition is met.

settings.label: Duration
settings.summary: Stop after this many elapsed minutes.
settings.description: Use 0 to disable the duration limit. Elapsed time is measured by the run session and excludes time after the stopping state begins.

settings.label: Battle limit
settings.summary: Stop after this many completed battle attempts.
settings.description: Use 0 to disable the battle-count limit. Failed attempts count because they consume route time and may consume limited attacks.

settings.label: Stop when Star Bonus is complete
settings.summary: End the session after the selected route's Star Bonus is complete.
settings.description: The route must expose a verified Star Bonus state. This option does not infer completion from a fixed battle count.

settings.label: Failure limit
settings.summary: Stop after repeated failed battle or navigation attempts.
settings.description: Prevents an unattended session from looping through an unrecognized or changed game state. Use 0 only during supervised diagnostics.

sections.title: Resource targets
sections.description: Optional cumulative loot targets for the current run session.

settings.label: Gold target
settings.summary: Stop when cumulative Gold reaches this value.
settings.description: Use 0 to disable. The target uses loot recorded during this run, not the current storage balance.

settings.label: Elixir target
settings.summary: Stop when cumulative Elixir reaches this value.
settings.description: Use 0 to disable. The target uses loot recorded during this run, not the current storage balance.

settings.label: Dark Elixir target
settings.summary: Stop when cumulative Dark Elixir reaches this value.
settings.description: Use 0 to disable. Builder Base routes ignore this target because that resource is not part of the route.

sections.title: Accounts and upgrades
sections.description: Choose which local profiles participate and whether resources may be spent on upgrades.

settings.label: Upgrade policy
settings.summary: Control whether the session may initiate upgrades.
settings.description: Upgrade actions remain subject to free-builder, resource, exclusion, and current-screen checks. The default never spends resources.

options.label: Do not upgrade
options.summary: Never initiate an upgrade during this run.
options.description: Resource collection and battle execution remain active, but no wall, building, Hero, pet, equipment, or laboratory upgrade is started.

options.label: Walls only
options.summary: Permit verified wall upgrades when configured conditions pass.
options.description: Uses the selected wall level, resource preference, builder reservation, and storage thresholds. Current wall recognition must pass.
options.disabled_reason: Town Hall 18 wall recognition and costs are not yet verified.

options.label: Suggested upgrades
options.description: Reads the current suggested-upgrade surface and applies configured exclusions before selecting an item.
options.disabled_reason: The current suggested-upgrade surface has not completed fixture validation.

options.label: Configured automatic upgrades
options.summary: Permit every explicitly enabled upgrade category.
options.description: Combines the profile's building, wall, Hero, pet, equipment, and laboratory rules. It never bypasses exclusions or spending thresholds.
options.disabled_reason: The full current-client upgrade catalog is not implemented.
options.warning: This option may spend substantial in-game resources.

settings.label: Account queue
settings.summary: Order the local profiles used during this run.
settings.description: Queue entries contain profile identifiers, labels, enabled state, and order only. Authentication material is never stored in the run plan.
settings.empty_state: No account queue selected; the active profile will be used.
